SEQUENCE.COMMENT: === 1. Read and parse the XML payload ===

INVOKE.COMMENT: The partner sends the XML as the text of the JMS message, so the body string is the XML to parse. JMSMessage is dropped here so that it does not collide with the message built for the send.
item is forced to a list: with a single item in the order the parser would otherwise produce a record, and the copy to the items list would be lost.
The consumer (demoOrderManagement) is another Integration Server service, so the canonical order is sent as an IData in body/data.
